rule_summary: Chat interaction configuration includes goal/style, response length, and custom prompts, all of which are notebook-scoped settings [1].
Note export and note-to-source conversion are explicitly out of scope for this screen [3, 5].
Saving chat history or specific responses must result in the creation of a real notebook note via the notes.create SDK method, rather than a text-based source [1-4].
Valid values for chat goal/style are 'default', 'learning-guide', and 'custom' [4].
Valid values for response length are 'default', 'longer', and 'shorter' [4].
